newsitem.title: USA: Donna Karan hands over CEO post to John Idol.
newsitem.headline: Donna Karan hands over CEO post to John Idol.

text.p: Donna Karan handed over the reins of her design house, which has seen its stock price founder over the past year, to Polo Ralph Lauren executive John Idol on Monday.
Idol will become chief executive and a member of the board of Donna Karan International Inc on August 11. He was formerly group president and a division chief operating officer at Polo Ralph Lauren.
Idol gets "full authority to lead and manage" the company, Karan said in a statement.

"A global company of this size and complexity needs one person who can concentrate on the business and lead its management", who can both respect the creative vision and create shareholder value, she said.

The company had planned to name a co-chief executive officer to serve with Stephen Ruzow, as it said in June, but gave Idol the sole position. Ruzow remains president and chief operating officer, reporting to Idol.
